property_summary: After calling init with coolOffPeriod unset, calling cancelProposal(1,2) reverts due to require(mapPID_finalising[oldProposalID]) because the contract fails to set coolOffPeriod to 1 (defaults to 0), causing mapPID_finalising[1] not to be true (since finaliseProposal checks require((block.timestamp - mapPID_timeStart[proposalID]) > coolOffPeriod) which incorrectly allows immediate finalisation, but the revert happens earlier because cancelProposal requires mapPID_finalising[1] to be true and that was never set because the contract skips the require in finaliseProposal due to coolOffPeriod = 0 causing the check to pass immediately; actually simpler: in the reference, coolOffPeriod=1 so finalising cannot be set instantly, so cancelProposal on a non-finalising proposal reverts; in the bug, coolOffPeriod=0 so finalising can be set instantly via voteProposal, allowing cancelProposal to succeed without revert).
change_summary: Delete the statement that sets coolOffPeriod, leaving it at its default value of 0.
